name: luma/ray/3.2/image-to-video
description: Agent Ray 3.2 by Luma - animate still images into dynamic videos with AI. Transform photos into cinematic clips with natural motion, camera movement, and optional audio generation.

hdr.title: Hdr
hdr.description: Generate an HDR-encoded MP4. Requires HDR access on the account and a resolution of 720p or 1080p; not supported with loop.

loop.title: Loop
loop.description: Generate a seamless loop. Only valid for standard-dynamic-range generations without an end frame or keyframes.

image.title: Image Url
image.description: URL of the image used as the first frame of the video. Provide either image_url (optionally with end_image_url) or keyframes — the two anchoring modes are mutually exclusive.

prompt.title: Prompt
examples: Low-angle shot of a majestic tiger prowling through a snowy landscape, leaving paw prints on the white blanket.
prompt.description: Text prompt describing the motion/scene to generate.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Duration of the generated video. 10s requires multi-keyframe input (keyframes / keyframe_indexes); it is not supported with a single image_url / end_image_url anchor.

end_image.title: End Image Url
end_image.description: Optional URL of an image used as the last frame. When set, the model interpolates between image_url and end_image_url. Cannot be combined with keyframes.

keyframes.title: Keyframes
keyframes.description: Multi-keyframe image-to-video guide frames: 1-64 image URLs pinned at the positions given by keyframe_indexes. Mutually exclusive with image_url, end_image_url, and loop; unlocks 10s and HDR. Provide keyframes and keyframe_indexes together (same length).

exr_export.title: Exr Export
exr_export.description: Also export an EXR file alongside the MP4. Requires hdr=true and HDR access.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: Resolution of the generated video. Higher resolutions cost more.

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated image.

keyframe_indexes.title: Keyframe Indexes
keyframe_indexes.description: Output-frame positions (duration x 24fps: 5s -> 0-120, 10s -> 0-240) where each keyframes[i] is anchored. Non-negative, unique, and the same length as keyframes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the generation task.

error.description: Error message if the task failed. Empty on success.

model.description: Model ID used for the prediction.

status.description: Status of the task: pending, running, completed, failed, or timeout.

url.description: The URL where the generated content can be downloaded from.

content_type.description: The MIME type of the output file.

outputs.description: Array of generated content. Empty when status is not completed.

readme:
# Luma Ray 3.2 Image to Video

Luma Ray 3.2 image-to-video: animate a first frame (optionally toward an end frame or keyframes) into a 5 or 10 second clip, with optional HDR.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | — | Up to 6,000 characters. |
| `image` | image URL, required | — | First frame. JPEG, PNG, or WebP URL. |
| `end_image` | image URL | — | Optional last frame. |
| `resolution` | `540p` / `720p` / `1080p` | `720p` | Sets the per-second rate. |
| `duration` | 5 / 10 | 5 | Output length in seconds. |
| `loop` | boolean | false | Make the clip loop. |
| `keyframes` | string[] | — | Optional keyframe images. |
| `keyframe_indexes` | integer[] | — | Frame positions for `keyframes`. |
| `exr_export` | boolean | false | Also export EXR frames with HDR; triples the price. |
| `hdr` | boolean | false | 16-bit HDR output (720p and 1080p); doubles the price. |
| `aspect_ratio` | `21:9` / `16:9` / `4:3` / `1:1` / `3:4` / `9:16` | `16:9` | Output frame shape. |

## Billing

$0.50 per 5-second clip at 540p, $1.00 at 720p, $2.00 at 1080p; 10 seconds costs double. HDR doubles and HDR with EXR export triples the 720p/1080p price.

| Output | 540p | 720p | 1080p |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5s (default) | $0.50 | $1.00 | $2.00 |
| 10s | $1.00 | $2.00 | $4.00 |
| 5s HDR | $0.50 | $2.00 | $4.00 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Describe what moves and how the camera behaves.

## Limits

- Clips are 5 or 10 seconds.
